entities.name: Founding & Bulgar-Slavic Fusion

entities.summary: Khan Asparuh's victory over Byzantium and the founding of the Bulgarian state (681). The fusion of Turkic Bulgars and Slavic populations, with Khans Tervel and Krum expanding the state's power and territory.
